title: Atiq Jameh Mosque of Shiraz

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain near the central pavilion within the mosque courtyard.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap mosque, connected range and courtyard pavilion (ODbL 1.0)
mapIdentity.scope: The named mosque outline follows the prayer halls and arcades around the courtyard. Its attached north range and the pavilion inside the same site come from individual OSM ways.

note: Three exact 2007 photos fix the north iwan, its roofed turrets, muqarnas ceiling and stone pavilion. The architectural record and mapped dimensions guide the other courtside walls.
